name: on-demand-savior
description: Pauses Claude before the 5-hour or weekly limit spills into on-demand usage, writes a handoff, and resumes from it once the limit resets

fiveHourThreshold.title: 5-hour threshold (%)
fiveHourThreshold.description: Pause once the 5-hour limit reaches this percent used

weeklyThreshold.title: Weekly threshold (%)
weeklyThreshold.description: Pause once the weekly limit reaches this percent used

onDemandBudgetUsd.title: On-demand budget (USD)
onDemandBudgetUsd.description: On-demand usage to let through once a limit is used up, then pause; 0 pauses at the thresholds instead

handoffDir.title: Handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Folder to keep handoffs in: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the project; empty uses the project's .claude/handoffs
